items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: So now I go through about six bass players, and I finally got Monty Budwig.

ctx.x: So all of a sudden, somebody shows up and brings in George Shearing to listen to this trio, and it just so happened that he was looking for a drummer and a bass -- and there went my bass and drums. And then I'm dead again.

So now I go through about six bass players, and I finally got Monty Budwig. And we were having our problems with the drums. I couldn't depend on Frank Butler, because he'd sell his drums; he was sick, you know, with the needle.
